steps.content: This is a towering abandoned structure that stands ominously in the wilderness. It resembles a dilapidated castle piled up with debris and fragments.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mr. Chief, this place is so bleak...
steps.female_content: Miss Chief, this place is so bleak...

steps.content: Its exterior does live up to its title, the eerie castle of doom and mystery.
As you prepare to enter, you hear some chattering behind you.

steps.speaker: Visitor A
steps.content: So this is it, that super spooky haunted castle?

steps.speaker: Visitor A
steps.content: I only came because you promised it'd be absolutely thrilling. It doesn't look too special to me though.

steps.speaker: Visitor B
steps.content: But, but this is the building from that famous Eastside strange tale! There must be a lot of scary stuff inside!

steps.speaker: Visitor A
steps.content: Haha, who cares about scary tales these days? Is there anything scarier than Mania and Corruptors?

steps.speaker: Visitor C
steps.content: Alright, stop teasing him. This is the first time Parker's led a crew. He's done lots of preparation for our adventure... Hey, good evening!
An older man interrupts the bickering pair. He then notices you and greets you in a casual, friendly manner.

steps.speaker: Visitor C
steps.content: I didn't expect to see other people here. Perhaps there is indeed something special about this place!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...G-good evening!
Letta promptly greets them back. The young woman next to the man elbows him and comes over warmly to introduce herself and her friends to you.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Nice to meet you, I'm Jennifer. This is Brown, and that's Parker. They're my friends from an outdoor adventure club. We team up to explore mysterious places sometimes.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Are you here for an adventure too?
You can say that.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Aha, we only came in the middle of the night because Parker swore this was a famous strange tale location.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Since we have a common goal, why don't we go in together?
The suggestion seems to appeal to Letta and she agrees right away.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... Of course! The more the merrier!
Having agreed on that, the freshly bonded adventure crew begins their journey in high spirits.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Wow, it's pitch dark here... I told you we should bring some flashlights. You guys said candles were more atmospheric? Awesome, now we can't see a thing.

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: That was Parker. I didn't suggest the candles.
The interior of the castle is way bigger, darker, and more complex than you imagined.
There are numerous big and small rooms isolated from each other and only connected by meandering narrow passages. The candles brought by Jennifer and her friends are clearly insufficient.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: The candles are not that useless...
Parker protests feebly. Letta nods in agreement.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Right, it's super atmospheric to explore an abandoned residence with a candle! Like a scene taken out of a classic adventure tale!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But if you're worried you can't see the path clearly, come closer to me. My lantern covers a bigger range!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: ...You're a lifesaver!
Jennifer is the first to huddle over and she links her arm with Letta's.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Thank god Letta's lantern is bright enough, or we'll fall to our death before we get to experience the strange tale! Thanks so much, Letta!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Haha... Anytime!
From then on, everyone stays close to Letta so she becomes the center of the illumination.
You pick a room randomly. As soon as Letta pushes the door open, a shadow falls abruptly from above and hits her head.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Ahhh!
Watch out!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I, I'm fine!
Letta rubs at where she just got hit and looks down at that unknown object.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Oh... It's a little pigeon.
She picks up the pigeon plushie that was hanging above the doorway and gently brushes off the dust on it.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Poor thing, it's missing its eyes and a wing. Now even the cotton is spilling out...
Next to her, Jennifer is also examining the tattered toy.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: It's pretty badly damaged. But it's fine, it can still be mended.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Mended?

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: Jennifer is a seasoned plushie designer. Mending these fluffy little things is her expertise.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Uh-huh, that's right. This one here is just a piece of cake!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Letta, do you like it a lot?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hmm... It's a pigeon. I don't want it to spend its life here where it never sees light.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: At least, I want to give it a pair of intact wings...

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: How about you give it to me and I'll return it to you once I'm done mending it. I can add as many pairs of wings as you want!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Consider it a gift for my new friend!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Are you sure? That's too kind of you, thank you!
Hugging the pigeon toy, she lifts her head and looks at Jennifer in amazement.
Jennifer takes the toy from Letta and gently pinches her plump cheek.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Haha, not at all. That's because I like you a lot too, Letta!
Next, the crew explores a few more rooms and finds that the arrangements are more or less the same. Other than abandoned furniture, there's only debris of construction materials.
When the initial excitement wears off, everyone is no longer nervous and the thrilling adventure gradually becomes an ordinary nighttime outing.

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: That's the last room on the top floor... I suppose that's everything.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: So many rooms and all we've seen is broken furniture. See, I told you there was nothing scary about it. This is just an ordinary abandoned residential building.
Jennifer yawns listlessly.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: The places you pick are boring, Parker. Well, let's look for some fun on our own next time.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: It's quite late now. Why don't we get out of here first?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Sigh, so even this strange tale is fake... Anyway, I still had a lot of fun today!
Letta is only disappointed for a brief moment before she cheers herself up and says to you with a smile.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Let's head back, shall we?
Yes. Adventure done, time to go home.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: No... no way! The strange tale is real. There must be other secrets we haven't discovered!
Parker shoves at the others and dashes straight ahead.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: Wait here. I'll show you guys!

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: Hey, don't go alone!
Parker sprints recklessly in the dark corridor illuminated by only the dim candlelight. Before Brown catches up with him, he trips on something and falls. The flame touches the front of his shirt.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: Ahhh!
He throws away the candle clumsily and pats his clothes hysterically. The discarded candle happens to land on a pile of old furniture and the sparks set the wood on fire.
The narrow passage is instantly ablaze, the flames lapping the wall and spreading across the whole plane.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: H-help me!
Still in shock, Parker is yanked back by Brown from the source of the fire. Jennifer immediately seizes his collar and shouts.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Are you out of your mind?!

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: I-I didn't do it on purpose...!

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: Shut it now!
You try to sprint through the flames, but the fire is too big to break through.
The fire is spreading too fast and the building is filled with inflammable objects. The whole structure will soon become an inferno. We must think of a way to get out quickly.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: But the fire has already blocked the way before us...

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: What if... we jump out of the window?

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: No, it's too high. Even if it doesn't kill you, it'll definitely maim you.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Then, then are we supposed to just count down to our death now?!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: No... I don't want to die! I'd rather jump off from here!

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: No! Calm down! Damn it... Parker, stop her!
As the three spiral into anxiety and despair, Letta whispers to you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mr. Chief, I have an idea...
steps.female_content: Miss Chief, I have an idea...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: If we move between the rooms, we can avoid the fire. But to do that... I must lead everyone through the walls.
But the second you use your power, your Sinner identity will be exposed.
Your parents have warned you in the letter too. The public is blatantly prejudiced against Sinners. Can you really handle the consequences of exposing your identity?
I don't mean to stop you... I only wish that you can consider it thoroughly before making the choice.
Letta nods firmly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I understand what you mean... But no amount of consideration can save us from this now.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Nothing comes before saving lives!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Especially when they're so nice to me even though we only just met. She even agreed to mend the pigeon for me. We're friends now... I can't just leave my friends like that.
If you've made up your mind, go for it. I'll support you no matter what.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Thank you!
Having made her decision, Letta walks determinedly over to her panicking friends, the lantern in her hand radiating an even brighter and softer light.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Everyone, please calm down... I know a way to get all of us out safely, as long as you trust me.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: You know a way?!
A spark of hope flickers in Jennifer's eyes, then goes out.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: No, there are no other ways. The only path is blocked, unless we can move through the flames...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: That I can't do... But I can lead you guys through the walls.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: ...Through the walls?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Yes. To prove it to you, I'll demonstrate it once!
Under their bewildered gaze, Letta, carrying her lantern, gradually sinks into the wall until she completely disappears.
A moment later, she emerges from the wall again, returning from the other side.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You see? Now you believe me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Come on, give me your hands. Once we pass through these rooms, we'll find a safe escape route...
Letta reaches out her hand sincerely, but no one responds.

steps.speaker: Brown
steps.content: Normal people can't do that... This power... You, you're a...

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: You're a Sinner!
Their expressions grow even more terrified and they step back, as if facing a disaster even worse than the fire.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I'm sorry I hid that from you, but now is not the time for discussion. It's too dangerous here, we need to get out at once...
Letta wants to grab the hand of Jennifer, who's closest to her, but Jennifer slaps her hand off.

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Back off, you freak! Don't touch me!
Jennifer begins screaming in fear and even throws something at her.
Letta freezes. She slowly turns her gaze toward the floor. A dusty little pigeon rolls twice there.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Why... must you act like that? I'm only trying to save you...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Aren't we friends?

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Who wants to be friends with a freak like you?!

steps.speaker: Jennifer
steps.content: Damn it, she touched me... I don't want to turn into a disgusting thing like that!

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You won't accept my help just because I'm a Sinner?
Facing the group who look at her entirely differently now, Letta seems hurt and confused.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Perhaps Father and Mother are right. I indeed oversimplify the idea of choice-making...

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Did I... make the wrong choice this time...?
Her hand is still reaching out, but it's shaking slightly now. Her initially firm stance begins to waver too.
You stride over and grab Letta's cold hand. You grip it firmly so that you can pass your warmth and strength to her.
I believe in you, Letta.
I'm putting my life in your hands. Take me out of here.

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: Oi, hold on, but she's a Sinner!

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: I hear that coming in contact with them turns you into a monster! It'll disfigure you completely! Aren't you scared?

steps.speaker: Parker
steps.content: ...I know, you two were together in the first place! Are you also a...
A disfigured monster? If you don't run now, soon enough you'll become a disfigured, charred body too.
You snicker and refute.
Stay here and get burned into a piece of horrifying charcoal, or get out alive and continue living your life... Anyone with rational judgment knows which one's the right choice.
If you insist on being stubborn, then the regretful result will not be caused by fire or Mania, but foolish prejudice.
Their faces have gone ashen and their expressions are awful. You turn back and ask Letta in a gentle voice.
Do you still want to save them?
It's alright. It's all up to you.
You're free to choose what to do and how to do it. You don't need to change your mind for any reason.
Listen, Letta... Whether or not a choice is right is not that important. What's important is that you won't regret it.
You've told me before that if it's your own choice, even if you're faced with setbacks, you'll accept it.
Therefore, what you need to do now is to face this situation and make your choice once more.
I'll leave you the freedom of choice. I won't question your decision.
Only the crackling of the fire can be heard in the scorching air. The group finally realize the grim reality and begin turning their fearful but anticipating gaze toward Letta.
After a moment of silence, Letta grips your hand again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I've decided... I'll take your hand, only yours.
Despair spreads across the group instantly. Letta speaks again.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But I won't stop anyone from following me.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I'm also giving you the freedom of choice. I'm not offering my help again. Whether you want to be saved by a disgusting Sinner or not is up to you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The fire is worsening... Mr. Chief, let's go!
steps.female_content: The fire is worsening... Miss Chief, let's go!

steps.content: With that, Letta immediately turns around with her lantern and pulls you into the wall.
Hands linked, you and Letta swiftly traverse the unscathed rooms. You notice the silent followers behind you, but you both pay no attention to them.
When you finally make it out, the castle has already become an inferno. The deceptive strange tale will no longer exist.
You contact the FAC to contain the disaster. Once they arrive, you take Letta away from the site quietly.
On the way back, Letta keeps staring out the window silently. So you pull out something and hand it to her.

options: I want to give this back to you.

choices.text: I want to give this back to you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...What?
It's that tattered pigeon plushie, only it's even dustier now having survived the fire. But Letta seems pleasantly surprised and hugs it lovingly.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: You salvaged it!
Yes, I knew you wouldn't want to leave it there.
Some Sinners in the Bureau are good at handcraft. Go find Lynn and ask her for help. I'm sure she'll be more than happy to oblige.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: I will...!
By the way, you've successfully executed your own Growth Plan today. Congratulations.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Eh, does that count as a success? I've had so many accidents...
Letta bows her head in embarrassment.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But indeed, what's an adventure if it's without surprises or accidents?
After today, I'm sure you now have a better understanding of what consequences you may face when you make your own choices. Tell me, do you still want to carry on with this plan?

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: ...Of course! I won't give up.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Father and Mother may be right about one thing. I'm probably not good at making the right choices.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: But that doesn't justify taking away the control I have over my life.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Mr. Chief, thank you so much for leaving me the greatest freedom of all... The freedom to make my own choice under any circumstances.
steps.female_content: Miss Chief, thank you so much for leaving me the greatest freedom of all... The freedom to make my own choice under any circumstances.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: The initial motivation for making my own Growth Plan was to preserve this power.
She flashes a determined and bright smile at you.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: That's why I will continue striving for it!
And my answer is the same. If that's your final decision, I'll support you as always.
I'm curious to know what other thrilling adventures Letta's Growth Plan will lead to.

steps.speaker: Letta
steps.content: Hehe, then from now on... please join me on more adventures!
